policy: Use release timing and narrative-era labels to exclude physical redesigns that postdate the game, while keeping multiple pre-game component/print generations visual-pending. Treat catalog entries from the same set and same character that differ only by mold revision as one physical release family rather than distinct narrative variants.

physical_candidate.catalog_name: Imperial Inquisitor Fifth Brother - Dark Bluish Grey

records.reason: The 2016 Rebels Fifth Brother is the only supported physical release that predates the April 2022 game. The live-action black-uniform Fifth Brother in 75336 launched on 1 August 2022, so it cannot establish source equivalence for the game asset. The pre-game Rebels family is verified; exact artwork reuse remains visual pending.

rejected_post_launch_candidate.catalog_name: Astromech Droid, R4-P17, Light Blue Rectangles

records.reason: The 2013 blue-rectangle and 2016/2017 yellow-orange-rectangle R4-P17 versions both predate the game. The light-blue-rectangle revision in 75333 launched in August 2022, four months after the game. Exact pre-game rectangle/printing generation remains visual pending.

records.reason: The source key is ordinary Jar Jar, not the later Darth Jar Jar novelty/alternate-universe figure. Two ordinary physical design generations predate the game, differing in head/torso treatment, and require visual comparison for exact mapping.

systemic_findings: Catalog records from the same set and same character that differ only by head-mold revision should be grouped as one physical release family.
A physical figure released after the game cannot be used as source-equivalence evidence even when it shares the game's release year.
Generic species/role identities remain component-generation ambiguous unless the source carries a distinguishing visual or semantic state.
